title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier Tempered Glass Solid Brass Hardware | Antique Pewter | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier | Allied Brass
description:
Add organized storage to your bathroom vanity area with a wall mount glass shelf built for everyday use in Antique Pewter, which offers a soft, silvery-gray tone with subtle warmth, bridging traditional and contemporary aesthetics. This triple-tier shelf features 3/8-inch thick tempered, beveled-edge glass paired with solid brass hardware to support bathroom essentials while keeping counters clearer.

Highlights:
- Antique Pewter blends effortlessly with transitional decor
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Solid brass hardware for enduring support
- Concealed screw mounting for a clean, modern look
- Multiple designer finish options available to coordinate with modern bathroom hardware and contemporary bath accessories

Specs:
- Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
- Overall size: 16 inches L x 5 inches W x 15 inches H
- Weight capacity: 6 lb
- Mounting: Wall mount; concealed screw hardware
- Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4-inch
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

A crisp, contemporary choice for minimalist bathroom fixtures where wall-mounted storage saves floor space.
